title: A multi-session simultaneous EEG-fMRI dataset with online experience sampling
description: A multi-session dataset of simultaneous EEG-fMRI recorded from 24 healthy adults aged 18-35 while they performed a gradual-onset continuous performance task (GradCPT) and a resting-state condition with intermittent multidimensional experience sampling. The same protocol was repeated on two days. Carbon wire loop sensors in the EEG cap support artifact removal. The dataset also includes ECG, behavioral responses, and mental health surveys. It supports study of attentional fluctuations, mind-wandering, and the test-retest reliability of EEG-fMRI relationships.
methods_description: Data were acquired on a 3T Siemens MAGNETOM Prisma with a 64-channel head coil. Acquisition included an MPRAGE T1-weighted scan, a B0 field map, and multiband gradient-echo EPI BOLD scans (TR 2000 ms, 2 mm isotropic voxels). EEG was recorded with a Brain Products MR-compatible system (BrainAmp MRPlus, BrainCap MR with 31 EEG channels, 4 carbon wire loops, and 1 ECG channel) at 5 kHz. MRI TR markers were recorded in the EEG data for synchronization. Each participant completed two sessions with one GradCPT run and three resting-state experience-sampling runs.
